children.game_version: A 'freeze' game where children must shake (trasukha) when the music plays and freeze when it stops.

seniors.seated_version: Perform the 'shaking' motion with the torso and arms while seated, keeping time with the feet on the floor.
seniors.standing_version: Perform the 2/4 step with reduced travel, focusing on the rhythmic bounce rather than the full polka jump.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduce tempo by 20%; limit arm movements to shoulder height.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Active hand movements that accompany and strengthen the artistic content
movement_profile.footwork: Repetitive figures based on the polka step
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Group performance, often in couples, moving through the dance space
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Occasional jumps and whirling in more playful variations
movement_profile.partnering: Couples within a larger group context
movement_profile.posture: Upright but dynamic, ready for quick movements

signature_moves.description: The namesake 'shaking' motion that defines the dance's texture
signature_moves.name: Trasukha

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid stiff or static upper bodies; the dance requires constant emotional and physical dynamism

music_profile.musical_form: Simple, colorful melodies with the same modal basis as circle songs
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Square melodies with repetitive rhythmic figures typical of polka
music_profile.sound_description: A bright, rhythmic sound dominated by the 'triple music' of violin, cymbals, and bagpipes, creating a driving 2/4 pulse.
music_profile.vocal_style: Often accompanied by folk songs of the same name

basic_steps: Establish a 2/4 pulse with a light, bouncing posture
Execute the 'shaking' (trasukha) motion through the torso and limbs
Perform repetitive polka-based step sequences in couples
Integrate expressive hand gestures to signal mood changes
Coordinate movements with the group to maintain the 'mass' performance feel
teaching.formation: Mass performance by an unlimited number of participants, often broken into couples
teaching.level_notes: The dance is based on 'easy movements' but requires high stamina and expressive coordination.
teaching.rhythm: 2/4 time signature with a square melodic structure
